title: Too expensive by half!
text: Too expensive by half!. This little frame is fine -- until you factor in the cost!  As usual, being the inveterate Amazon shopper that I am, once I found what I wanted I ordered it without considering the price.  I'm sure there are other options out there where you won't have to pay this ludicrous price.
